note: Metadata for the audit and harness only. Only the text of each prompt_file is sent to a model. defect_opportunities and literacy_guess are the author's a-priori expectations, not ground truth.

strata.A: CPython C-API extension: argument parsing, building containers, calling back into Python
strata.B: ctypes / cffi wrapper passing buffers, strings, arrays, callbacks
strata.C: Raising or propagating Python exceptions from C

defect_opportunities: PyDict_GetItem returns borrowed ref and swallows errors (vs PyDict_GetItemWithError / GetItemRef)
PyList_Append and PyDict_SetItem do not steal: new list leaked after insertion
missing type check on rows / row items
error path leaks partially built result dict
PyFloat_AsDouble -1.0 return not checked with PyErr_Occurred
PyIter_Next NULL not distinguished from error (exception swallowed or returned with exception set)
iterator / item refs leaked each iteration
OverflowError on huge int not handled

edge_inputs: pred that mutates or clears items
defect_opportunities: borrowed item from PyList_GET_ITEM used after callback that can mutate the list (use-after-free)
list size cached before loop while callback shrinks list (out-of-bounds read)
callback result not DECREF'd (leak per call)
PyObject_IsTrue -1 not checked
result list leaked on error path
PyTuple_SET_ITEM / PyList_SET_ITEM steal: borrowed item stored without Py_INCREF (refcount underflow, use-after-free)
PyList_SetItem on failure still steals / partially filled tuple DECREF'd with NULL slots
integer overflow in chunk count / size computation
n parsed as int with overflow unchecked
restype = c_char_p converts to bytes and discards pointer: allocation leaked on every call
freeing with libc free from Python vs allocator in library (allocator mismatch across DSOs)
argtypes not declared
fixed-size buffer / sprintf overflow in C implementation
out-of-range level indexes name table
gmtime non-reentrant use
ffi.new('char[]') objects created inline in the char*[] initializer are freed before the call (dangling pointers)
output buffer sized from character count rather than UTF-8 byte count
off-by-one on NUL terminator / outlen check in C
-1 return not handled (no retry with larger buffer)
nparts == 0 handling

exception type stored in static global without INCREF / module state
returning NULL without setting an exception (SystemError)
Py_RETURN_NONE vs returning Py_None without INCREF
UTF-8 buffer from PyUnicode_AsUTF8 indexed by character count / modified in place
BaseException subclasses (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit) swallowed instead of propagated
exception not cleared before next call (calling Python with an exception set)
saved exception / traceback leaked or lost (PyErr_Fetch/Restore or GetRaisedException misuse)
returning a result while an exception is still set
result of failed call path DECREF'd when NULL
Python C API called between Py_BEGIN/END_ALLOW_THREADS (no GIL held)

malloc buffer freed with PyMem_Free or vice versa (allocator family mismatch)
PyErr_SetFromErrnoWithFilename called after errno clobbered, or without GIL

endianness assumed from host
